dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: This fragment seems a little larger than any of the previous ones we've found. Let me analyze it with the Energy Amplifier and run some numbers.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: It's a genuine slice of ancient history! An artifact that can conduct and amplify energy. It's another object of my research.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: If you're interested, feel free to try it out for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Goodness... I had no idea that there were such energy-rich fragments out there. None of the other fragments we've found so far are anything like as big as this one.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: If my theory is correct, a fragment like this should have attracted a whole horde of dangerous monsters.... which begs the question: How did you manage to get your hands on it?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: ...Miss Yingzhu, I regret to inform you that I shall be canceling my commission with the Adventurers' Guild with immediate effect.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Traveler... How would you like to take on a new commission?

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Wait! You can't do that, Sumeru Akademiya signed a contract with us!

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Ahem, and in any case — this Traveler is actually one of ours.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Oh, really? That's lucky. This is the most energy-rich fragment I've seen so far. I simply must collect some data on it.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: With this Traveler's help, my undergraduate thesis, "A Study on the Internal Energy Flow of Developing Irminsul Fruit," is saved!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: It will be an epoch-defining study! By conducting a sequence of tests adopting a phase-wise approach, I will examine localized energy transfer and transformation within the Irminsul Fruit during a single developmental cycle, in the hope of isolating and identifying the defining features of Irminsul energetics...

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: ...Please, Hosseini. We don't understand a word you are saying...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Time to talk specifics. What I'd like you to do is to head to a domain that we previously discovered and conduct a practical test.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: It's a very straightforward procedure. All you need to do is place the fragments into the Energy Amplifier and take it inside with you. This will activate its energy conduction and amplification effects.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I'll give you the Energy Amplifier now. As long as you draw energy from the Irminsul Fruit fragment while exploring the domain, I will receive data on my end.

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: Traveler, no one is disputing your ability, but please be on your guard in that domain. It's extremely dangerous.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: There. It's up to you, now.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Ahem... Let's not concern ourselves with trivial details like that. Suffice to say, there are those of us at the Akademiya who are fortunate enough to undergo a... prolonged period of scrutiny by the God of Wisdom.

response.speaker: Yingzhu
response.text: I'm not educated by any description, but I think Soraya from Wangshu Inn told me something about this... "deferred graduation," isn't it?
